headline: Southern New Hampshire secure first place in the table
dek: Southern New Hampshire's goalless draw with Franklin Pierce took them to twenty points with their nine conference matches played, and the one match left between members, Franklin Pierce against Assumption, cannot carry either past them. American International beat Saint Anselm to move second on seventeen, a point ahead of Bentley.
displaced_by: Southern New Hampshire can no longer be caught, and American International's win over Saint Anselm ends the run the standing headline was about

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's fifty-two goals come from at least sixteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is the work of a squad rather than a single forward.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire can no longer be caught at the top of the conference table.

findings.text: Guillermo Rios has scored fifteen of Franklin Pierce's twenty-nine goals.

last_match.line: American International remain unbeaten at home this season, and the win ends Saint Anselm's winning run.

next_match.line: Pace have lost every match since beating American International.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
